item.title: Abtex clarifies 10 billion shillings support is a loan, not free money
item.description: Abtex, President of the Federation of Uganda Promoters Association, clarified that the 10 billion shillings support package from the government is a structured loan facility with a small interest rate, and he has so far received 1.5 billion shillings.
